details: @zmtcdn/ui 9999.0.0 and 9999.0.7 are dependency-confusion packages with an empty `index.js` and a description of "Security research PoC". Their postinstall script runs `node postinstall.js` on npm install, which POSTs the hostname, username, platform, working directory and the names of all environment variables to `https://www.hinny.shop/api`. They were published by the npm account kill_shs, which also published @zmtcdn/components with the same script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
